item.description:
The first release of Iconery, an icon library for macOS. It keeps your icons in sets, finds them again, and exports them in the formats and sizes a project needs. It can also bring over an existing IconJar library.
Needs macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon.
## Installing
1. Unzip `Iconery-0.1.0.zip` and drag Iconery into Applications. 2. Iconery isn't notarized, so macOS blocks it the first time. Open it once, then go to System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
From here on Iconery checks for updates once a day. You can turn that off in Settings ▸ General.
